description:
Checks a URL once for an agent, paid per call: status, response time, keyword and TLS certificate, with no account and no monitor.
One reading with the probe of the site monitors, and the certificate of an https address that answered. A request without payment gets the 402 with the price; a paid one gets the reading in the same response, with the payment in `cobranca`. A site that is down is the answer (`ok: false` with `reason`) and is charged: the call was made. When our own probe network fails, the answer is 503 and nothing is charged.

expect_status.description: What counts as up: `200-399` by default, a range `a-b` or one code.

keyword.description: Text that must be in the first 64 KB of the page; it forces `GET`.

url.description: The address to call: http or https, public, without user or password.

name: get_api_x402_check
title: Get API X402 check
